content_sections.heading: Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 381 vacant Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra locations are notified across the rural talukas of Thane district, as shown below.

content_sections.heading: Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Minimum age of 18 years. Minimum qualification: passed Higher Secondary School Certificate (12th / H.S.C.) examination. Basic computer knowledge is required; candidates holding an MSCIT or equivalent certificate will be given preference. Must be a local resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat area applied for (the entire Gram Panchayat area is treated as the geographic unit for this purpose). Must possess Aadhaar number, PAN, a bank account, and other necessary identity documents. Must not have been found guilty of moral turpitude, financial fraud, or cyber crime. Must have knowledge of Marathi and English.

content_sections.heading: Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Infrastructure Requirements
content_sections.text: Every Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra must have at least the following facilities: Minimum 100 sq. ft. of office space Two computers/laptops Laser printer Scanner Biometric device Webcam UPS or alternative power backup Broadband internet (10 Mbps in rural areas, 20 Mbps in urban areas) CCTV system Waiting area for citizens Government-authorised service-fee display board and an external nameboard

content_sections.heading: Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Setu Prabhari Officer and District Social Welfare Officer at the Collector's office jointly conduct scrutiny of applications. Based on the Government Resolution dated 23 August 2002 that established the District Setu Committee headed by the District Collector, the proposal is placed before the committee for a decision on granting Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra. Where more than one eligible application is received for the same geographic area, a marking process (as per the Electronics, IT and Artificial Intelligence Department's corrigendum dated 9 July 2026) is carried out. The committee's decision is final. The District-level Selection Committee conducts a structured interview of applicants, assessing: Knowledge of government services Citizen-centric service attitude Ability to handle digital systems Problem-solving ability Communication skills Integrity and ethics Awareness of data privacy and information security Preliminary scrutiny and document verification of applications. Examination of documents based on the marking criteria. Physical inspection of the proposed office premises. Police verification. Structured interview conducted by the District-level Selection Committee. Preparation of a merit list based on 100 marks. Publication of the preliminary selection list and invitation of objections. Final selection and issuance of the appointment order. Mandatory training and a 6-month probation period. Regularisation after satisfactory performance.

Experience (CSC, Maha-e-Seva Kendra, Banking Correspondent, e-Governance, or similar work)
Social Inclusiveness (differently-abled, ex-servicemen, women, self-help group members, local entrepreneurs)
Character Verification (police verification, no fraud/financial misconduct/blacklist history)

content_sections.heading: Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Disqualification Criteria
content_sections.text: An applicant will be declared ineligible under the following circumstances: Submitting false or fabricated documents. Being included in a blacklist under any government scheme. Having a serious or pending case of financial fraud or cyber crime.

content_sections.heading: Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Contract & Renewal Terms
content_sections.text: A selected Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) will initially be given a one-year contract. Further renewal will be based on performance indicators, including: Number of transactions conducted Citizen satisfaction index Average time taken to provide service Number of complaints received and their resolution Audit compliance System uptime Financial discipline Participation in various government campaigns

Submit the printed application with documents to the Resident Naib Tehsildar of the concerned taluka before 22 September 2026, during office hours (9:45 AM to 6:15 PM).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Application
content_sections.text: Aadhaar number, PAN card, and bank account details Proof of minimum age 18 years HSC (12th) pass certificate, and MSCIT or equivalent computer certificate, if held Self-attested identity and residence proof establishing local residency of the concerned Gram Panchayat area Police character verification certificate (mandatory to submit within 1 month of publication of the final eligible candidates list) Self-declaration form (Swayamghoshanapatra), in the prescribed format, signed by the applicant

faq.question: Q1. What is Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an application process, opened by the District Collector & District Magistrate Office, Thane, to select Village Level Entrepreneurs for 381 vacant Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra locations in rural Thane district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 381 vacant Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra locations across Ambernath (27), Kalyan (115), Thane (4), Bhiwandi (111), Murbad (76), and Shahapur (48) talukas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online Google Form can be filled until 20 September 2026, and the printed application with documents must be physically submitted to the Resident Naib Tehsildar before 22 September 2026, 6:15 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th (H.S.C.) examination and have basic computer knowledge; an MSCIT certificate is preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: A minimum age of 18 years is required. No maximum age limit is specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the online Google Form at forms.gle/ti2jwA9TeAhLCKZ56 in Marathi, print the form received on your registered email, attach the required documents, and submit it to the Resident Naib Tehsildar of your taluka before 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Thane DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-mark evaluation covering education, computer literacy, infrastructure, financial capacity, an interview, experience, business plan, social inclusiveness, and character verification, followed by document scrutiny, physical inspection, police verification, and a District-level Selection Committee merit list.
